preview: A two-round interview experience for a Full Time role covering technical questions on DSA, OOPs, DBMS, and behavioral questions.

Syntax for creating one ●What is indexing. Explain the types of indexing ●Asked me a simple puzzle. ●What will you do if you misunderstood instructions from your manager. ●Biggest achievement till date. ●Any questions ? Round 2 (30 mins) ●Asked me about binary Search again ): ●Asked about master slave architecture in DBMS. ●Asked me to implement stack, queue, binary tree from scratch. ●Find the duplicate in database records. ●Indexing ●The bulb puzzle (very common) ●Which languages do you know ? ●Difference between list and tuple. ●Asked me about the paper presented and the international competition ●How would you solve a conflict between teammates. ●How would you rate your presentation skills ? ●Do you know what Bank of America does ? ●Any questions
